reason: Edge is intraday price discovery at the open via OPG orders with fair-value projections and includes short selling, which cannot be approximated on daily bars or long-only engine.

universe.description: US equities, focus on mega caps with tight spreads

setup.rule: Project fair value from prior close adjusted by futures/beta
setup.quote: projecting where the fair value of the stock is and selling it short if it opens too high or buy it if it opens too low

entry.rule: Use OPG orders to buy below or short above fair value at open
entry.quote: I use mostly OPG orders... If it opens at 3070, I'm going to get 3070 short. If it opens at 3060, I'm not going to get filled.

exits.rule: Work out positions manually over ~30 min while hedging with SPY for market neutrality
exits.quote: I would just go and do exactly what I did hedge it... and then I can slowly manually work out of those positions over the course of the next half an hour

sizing.rule: Scale to many positions then hedge net exposure with SPY to stay market neutral
sizing.quote: if I'm allowing a million dollars worth of stock, I'm gonna sell short a million dollars worth of spy

market_filter.rule: Trade only around open/close; avoid 10:30-14:30 due to HFT dominance
market_filter.quote: Between 11 and 2, I don't even trade at all. 11am, 2pm, I call it toxic.

ambiguities.assumption: Classified intraday_only rather than discretionary/short-only since mixed long/short but core edge is open auction
